audit.method: code-review-combo (host-direct fallback: .ps1 unsupported by ocr delegate)

findings.issue: Recursion follows NTFS reparse points (junctions/symlinks); self-referential junctions (e.g. AppData\Local\Application Data) cause infinite recursion -> StackOverflowException / enumeration blow-up on -Root C:\ / D:\ scans.
findings.impact: Script crashes on the primary use case (live C:/D: scan).
findings.fix: Skip recursion into entries whose FileAttributes has ReparsePoint set (with try/catch).

findings.issue: Confirmation used $parent (parent dir) while actual deletion targets $it.Path (the dir itself); Confirm-Dir cache key also used $parent -> confirmed path != deleted path.
findings.impact: Misleading interactive prompt; possible wrong confirmation merge.
findings.fix: Use $it.Path as Confirm-Dir argument, prompt object and cache key.

findings.issue: Comment claims '-LiteralPath' / '-Recurse' but implementation uses underlying .NET [IO.File]::Delete / [IO.Directory]::Delete(path,$true).
findings.impact: Maintenance misunderstanding; risk of wrong rollback to hooked Remove-Item.
findings.fix: Update comment to match .NET API implementation.

findings.issue: Scan CSV defaulted to $PSScriptRoot (repo root); .gitignore omitted scan_inventory_*.csv / cleanup_plan.md / cleanup_plan_files.csv -> easy accidental commit.
findings.fix: Default OutScanCsv to $env:TEMP; add ignore rules to .gitignore; update param help.

findings.issue: Redundant UTF-8 BOM branch (same assignment as else).
findings.fix: Remove redundant UTF-8 BOM branch; keep UTF-16 LE/BE detection.

findings.issue: Header match is case-sensitive; external CSV with different casing is silently skipped.
findings.fix: Lower-case headers before IndexOf for case-insensitive matching.
Add Pester cases for Classify-C/D, Map-Cleanable, Read-CsvRecords, reparse guard (deferred; not a bug).
